permit.quote: The data is solely used for individual troubleshooting (as well as for identifying general defects which lead to unexpected crashes or errors) and is never shared with any third parties other than HockeyApp.

prohibit.quote: The data is used solely for individual troubleshooting (as well as for identifying general defects which lead to unexpected crashes or errors) and is never shared with any third parties other than Firebase from Google, Inc., which we use for analyzing crash reports (crashlytics).

conflicts.situation: Adblock Browser for iOS, a mobile product, crashes and its crash report data is sent to HockeyApp.
conflicts.reason: The crash reporter section covers all mobile products and allows sharing only with Firebase. The Adblock Browser for iOS section allows HockeyApp. Neither section excludes the other product or states which governs.

permit.quote: If required for legal proceedings / investigations, personal data will be transferred to the criminal investigation authorities and, if appropriate, to injured third parties.

prohibit.quote: We will never share or sell your email address, or any other information collected, to any third parties.

conflicts.situation: A user submits an email address in a website product campaign, and a legal investigation with indications of abusive behavior requests that user's data.
conflicts.reason: The campaign promise of never sharing any collected information with any third parties states no legal exception, and the legal disclosure clause does not say it overrides that promise.

permit.quote: In such transactions user information may be shared with the transmitted part of the company.

prohibit.quote: We will never share or sell your email address, or any other information collected, to any third parties.

conflicts.situation: eyeo sells a business unit, and campaign email addresses collected on its websites are part of the transferred user information.
conflicts.reason: The campaign section says collected information is never shared with any third party, without a business transfer exception. The business transfer clause covers user information generally and states no precedence.

conflicts.situation: eyeo uses a user's personal data, such as an account email address, to promote its products.
conflicts.reason: The long version restricts processing solely to listed purposes that omit promotion, while the short version lists promotion as a purpose. The policy does not say which list governs.

permit.quote: We may also collect information from and about the devices you use, including how you interact with the app and information about the device itself, such as the hardware model, operating system, IP address, device settings and advertising identifiers, language and time zone.

prohibit.quote: It's important to note that we do not collect any Personal Data (meaning information that can identify a specific individual).

conflicts.situation: The app collects a user's IP address and advertising identifier, which the policy says allow it to recognize and associate the user's activity.
conflicts.reason: The policy labels these identifiers non-personal but says they let it recognize and associate a user's activity, which fits its own definition of Personal Data. No statement reconciles the two.

permit.quote: We may also use all of your Data collected to offer you personalised advertisements, products, services or content

prohibit.quote: We only use this Data to appropriately analyze your concerns or identify related issues, and then to respond to your questions and requests.

conflicts.situation: A consenting player contacts support via in-game chat, giving name, country and device identifier, and Kolibri uses that data for personalised advertising.
conflicts.reason: The advertising clause covers all collected Data, including support data, while the support clause limits that data to handling requests. Neither clause carves out the other or states precedence.

permit.quote: to enable the operation and security of our Services, such as:, identifier of your device and the connection (IP address, MAC address), login dates and times, information concerning the device and the operating system you use.

prohibit.quote: We do not collect any other personal information such as your name, email address, date of birth unless you decide to share it with us (e.g. by changing your in-game name to your real name).

conflicts.situation: A player downloads and first plays a game without sharing anything, and Kolibri automatically collects the IP address, MAC address and device identifier.
conflicts.reason: The policy defines IP address as personal data, yet says nothing beyond install details and Player ID is collected at first play. The examples given do not limit the word any.
